label: The reachability diameter
subgoals: Run breadth-first search from the initial states
Record the distance of every reachable state
Take the largest distance as the reachability diameter

label: The recurrence diameter
subgoals: Enumerate loop-free paths from the initial states
Find the longest one, counting transitions
Compare it with the reachability diameter

label: Diameters of counters
subgoals: Trace the counter's states from reset as a single cycle
Use 2^n - 1 for one counter and lcm(a, b) - 1 for two lockstep counters
Conclude whether BMC to that depth is practical
